name: indic-legal-benchmark
description: Indic-Legal-Benchmark evaluates natural language understanding and related NLP tasks in Indian languages within the legal domain. It includes tasks such as classification and question answering on legal text to measure model performance on domain-specific, multilingual legal reasoning and information extraction. The benchmark is designed to test models' ability to handle legal vocabulary, long documents, and cross-lingual/legal-context understanding.
reputation: A niche but useful resource for Indian-language legal NLP with modest adoption among researchers working on regional-language legal tasks.
